about_the_game:
Hold onto your handlebars, hit the waves, and leave your rivals in your wake!

Get a taste of high-speed aquatic racing in the Tidal Rush Tech Demo – a casual yet adrenaline-charged water racer inspired by the golden era of kart games. Hop onto your Hydrospeeder and join our traveling entourage of racing enthusiasts across exotic planets, gliding over dynamic waters, unleashing tactical power-ups, and go all-in in fast-paced contests against AI, friends, or players worldwide.

Be part of it - your feedback is highly appreciated!

Heads up! You’re about to dive into a super early development version of our game. It might break, crash, or do funny dances it’s not supposed to. 

Do you want to help us shape the future of Tidal Rush or report a bug? Join our Discord and tell us what you think! Hope to see you there.

Feel free to also write a review on Steam. All feedback is highly appreciated!

What’s in the Demo:

Online Multiplayer
Compete against racers across the globe! Test your skills in intense online showdowns with up to eight players (*no built-in matchmaking yet). 

Two Vibrant Characters & Our First Track
Select one of our unique furry racers and take on the challenge of our very first track – Shatterstone Cavern. From a lush alien forest through crystalline caves, jumping across erupting geysirs.

Dive into the cosmic thrill of Tidal Rush! Experience the roaring waves, tackle daring races, and get a glimpse of the full adventure to come.

Whether you're chasing the leaderboard, challenging your friends, or mastering your racing style, get ready to make a splash — and leave them in your wake!

It's only the beginning! This awaits you in the future:

  • More Characters & Racetracks

  • New Race Features: Stunts, Diving, Slipstreaming...

  • A Singleplayer Campaign

  • New PVP Race Modes

  • Character- & Vehicle Customizations

  • Character Progression Systems

  • Matchmaking for Online-Multiplayer

  • An so much more...
